metadata.question: Did the surface water extent of Lake Mead decrease between July 6, 2000 and July 3, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 Surface Reflectance around Lake Mead polygon. Periods: 2000-07-06 ±60 days (LT05 + LE07) and 2022-07-03 ±60 days (LC08 + LC09). If no images, expand to ±120 days. 
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds, cirrus, cloud shadow, dilated cloud, and snow using QA_PIXEL bits. Scale SR bands. Compute MNDWI and threshold > 0.0 to classify water. 
3. Logic: Check collection sizes (C1). Count valid pixels after masking (C2). If any reduceRegion returns null/NaN (C3). Otherwise compare water areas; if 2022 < 2000 then A: Yes else B: No.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lakeMeadGeom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[-114.93, 36.50], [-114.93, 35.75], [-114.05, 35.75], [-114.05, 36.50], [-114.93, 36.50]]],
    null, false
  );

  const target1 = '2000-07-06';
  const target2 = '2022-07-03';
  const scale = 1000; // As per best practices to avoid timeout
  const maxPixels = 1e9;

  function windowDates(center, days) {
    const start = ee.Date(center).advance(-days, 'day');
    const end = ee.Date(center).advance(days, 'day');
    return { start, end };
  }

  // 2. Helpers
  function maskLandsatL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0);
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0);
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0);
    const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0);
    const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0);
    const mask = dilated.and(cirrus).and(cloud).and(cloudShadow).and(snow);
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  function applyScaleFactors(img) {
    const possible = ee.List(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7']);
    const present = ee.List(possible.filter(function(b) {
      return img.bandNames().contains(ee.String(b));
    }));
    const scaled = img.select(present).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }

  function addMNDWI(img) {
    const bnames = img.bandNames();
    const greenName = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(bnames.contains('SR_B3'), 'SR_B3', 'SR_B2'));
    const swir1Name = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(bnames.contains('SR_B6'), 'SR_B6', 'SR_B5'));
    const green = img.select(greenName);
    const swir1 = img.select(swir1Name);
    const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('mndwi');
    return img.addBands(mndwi);
  }

  function buildLandsatCollection(start, end, geom, sensors) {
    let col = ee.ImageCollection([]);
    sensors.forEach((s) => {
      col = col.merge(ee.ImageCollection(s).filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end));
    });
    return col
      .map(maskLandsatL2)
      .map(applyScaleFactors)
      .map(addMNDWI);
  }

  async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo((v, e) => e ? reject(e) : resolve(v)));
  }

  async function computePeriod(centerDate, sensors) {
    // Try ±60 days then ±120 days
    const w1 = windowDates(centerDate, 60);
    let col = buildLandsatCollection(w1.start, w1.end, lakeMeadGeom, sensors);
    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      const w2 = windowDates(centerDate, 120);
      col = buildLandsatCollection(w2.start, w2.end, lakeMeadGeom, sensors);
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        return { tag: 'C1', msg: `Images: 0` };
      }
    }
    const mosaic = col.median().clip(lakeMeadGeom);
    const mndwi = mosaic.select('mndwi');
    // Valid pixel count (mndwi not masked)
    const validCount = await getInfoAsync(
      mndwi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: lakeMeadGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('mndwi')
    );
    const totalCount = await getInfoAsync(
      ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: lakeMeadGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('c')
    );
    if (!totalCount || totalCount === 0) {
      return { tag: 'C3', msg: 'Total pixel count invalid' };
    }
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      return { tag: 'C2', msg: `Images: ${size}, valid px: 0` };
    }
    const cloudPct = (1 - (validCount / totalCount)) * 100.0;

    // Water area with MNDWI threshold
    const water = mndwi.gt(0.0).rename('water');
    const area_m2 = await getInfoAsync(
      water.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: lakeMeadGeom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('water')
    );
    if (area_m2 === null || area_m2 === undefined || isNaN(area_m2)) {
      return { tag: 'C3', msg: 'Area calc failed' };
    }
    const area_km2 = area_m2 / 1e6;
    return {
      tag: 'OK',
      size,
      validCount,
      totalCount,
      cloudPct,
      area_km2
    };
  }

  try {
    // Period 1 (2000): LT05 + LE07
    const p1 = await computePeriod(target1, [
      'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2',
      'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'
    ]);
    if (p1.tag !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2000 ${p1.msg}`);
      console.log('C1' === p1.tag ? 'C1' : (p1.tag === 'C2' ? 'C2' : 'C3'));
      return;
    }

    // Period 2 (2022): LC08 + LC09
    const p2 = await computePeriod(target2, [
      'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2',
      'LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2'
    ]);
    if (p2.tag !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2022 ${p2.msg}`);
      console.log('C1' === p2.tag ? 'C1' : (p2.tag === 'C2' ? 'C2' : 'C3'));
      return;
    }

    // 3. Evidence output (concise)
    const line1 = `2000 Images: ${p1.size}, ValidPx: ${p1.validCount}/${p1.totalCount}, Cloud%: ${p1.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%, Water_km2: ${p1.area_km2.toFixed(1)}`;
    const line2 = `2022 Images: ${p2.size}, ValidPx: ${p2.validCount}/${p2.totalCount}, Cloud%: ${p2.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%, Water_km2: ${p2.area_km2.toFixed(1)}`;
    console.log(line1);
    console.log(line2);

    // 4. Final decision
    if (!isFinite(p1.area_km2) || !isFinite(p2.area_km2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (p2.area_km2 < p1.area_km2) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
